lines.beaver: 민호 씨, 회의 끝나고 표정이 안 좋던데요.
lines.beaver_en: Minho, you didn't look good after the meeting.
lines.beaver_roman: minho ssi, hoeui kkeunnago pyojeongi an joteondeyo.
lines.learner: 박 과장님이 모두 앞에서 저를 무시했어요.
lines.en: Manager Park ignored me in front of everyone.
lines.roman: bak gwajangnimi modu apeseo jeoreul musihaesseoyo.

lines.learner: 제 기획안을 깎아내리고 저를 모욕까지 했어요.
lines.en: He belittled my proposal and even insulted me.
lines.roman: je gihoeganeul kkakkanaerigo jeoreul moyokkkaji haesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그냥 기분 탓일 수도 있지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: Couldn't it just be your feelings?
lines.beaver_roman: geunyang gibun tasil sudo itji anayo?
lines.en: No. Now even my teammates are shutting me out.

lines.beaver: 정말요? 다들 사정을 잘 모를 텐데요.
lines.beaver_en: Really? They probably don't know the whole story.
lines.beaver_roman: jeongmallyo? dadeul sajeongeul jal moreul tendeyo.
lines.en: The manager used a trick to make them misunderstand.

lines.learner: 사과가 능사는 아니에요. 제 잘못도 아닌데요.
lines.en: Apologizing isn't the answer. It's not even my fault.
lines.roman: sagwaga neungsaneun anieyo. je jalmotdo anindeyo.

lines.beaver: 그래도 이대로 두면 더 커지지 않을까요?
lines.beaver_en: But if you leave it, won't it get bigger?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo idaero dumyeon deo keojiji aneulkkayo?
lines.learner: 맞아요. 곧 완전히 등을 돌리게 될 거예요.
lines.en: Right. Soon we'll turn our backs on each other completely.
lines.roman: majayo. got wanjeonhi deungeul dollige doel geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you think the manager will react?

lines.beaver: 너무하네요. 민호 씨도 같이 덤빌 생각이에요?
lines.beaver_en: That's too much. Are you going to fight back too?
lines.beaver_roman: neomuhaneyo. minho ssido gachi deombil saenggagieyo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 제가 덤비면 다들 저를 손가락질할 거예요.
lines.en: No, if I lash out, everyone will blame me.
lines.roman: aniyo, jega deombimyeon dadeul jeoreul songarakjilhal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Shall I try to mediate between you?
lines.learner: 고마워요. 지은 씨마저 배신할까 봐 걱정했어요.
lines.en: Thanks. I was afraid even you would betray me.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. jieun ssimajeo baesinhalkka bwa geokjeonghaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럴 리가요. 내일 과장님과 자리 마련해 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: No way. I'll set up a meeting with him tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: geureol ligayo. naeil gwajangnimgwa jari maryeonhae bolgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 하소연 들어 줘서 정말 고마워요.
lines.en: Okay, thank you so much for hearing me out.
lines.roman: ne, hasoyeon deureo jwoseo jeongmal gomawoyo.
